claim_scope: computational HQ, not affinity or experimental hit rate

interface_pae_angstrom.definition: mean of both directed target-binder PAE entries for residue pairs with minimum inter-heavy-atom distance <=5 A

hotspot_coverage.definition: frozen hotspot residues with any binder heavy atom <=5 A / all frozen hotspot residues

severe_clash_count.definition: inter-chain non-H atom pairs separated by <1.5 A

target_site_ca_rmsd_angstrom.definition: CA RMSD of frozen site plus all target residues within 8 A in reference, after Kabsch alignment of all mapped target CA; require >=3 non-collinear mapped CA and complete site mapping

missingness: Any missing, nonfinite, invalid-scale or unmapped required metric makes the candidate unevaluable. Campaign primary HQ yield remains unavailable until every generated candidate is accounted for.
threshold_basis: Prospective operational benchmark definition selected before any comparative generation; these cutoffs are not experimentally calibrated for VHH or every family.
scope_gates: State, counterstate, glycan, membrane, crop and off-target constraints must be declared per frozen target before execution; unavailable mandatory constraints block that target equally for every method.
freeze_rule: The profile file SHA-256 is locked before outcomes. Runtime binding and smoke validation are still required before GPU authorization. No target-specific cutoff tuning.
